"""The store's tests (M7; R-STORE-1 to R-STORE-9), run by tools/fw-suite.py
after its suite: runs that need the flash another run left (fwtest's
--flash and --flash-out), so they are run here, one by one or four at a
time, rather than from tests/fw/boot.suite. Every input file (scripts,
flash images) is made under out/fw/store/, inside the repository, as
tools/fwtest needs; the outputs go to the suite's output folder, one
folder a run, named store-<case>-<run>.

Each flash image is read by tools/store.py, which follows store.c's rules
(docs/STORE-FORMAT.md). Where a case starts from an image tools/store.py
made, its Store model also predicts the image the firmware should leave,
command for command, and the two are compared byte for byte.

- persist (R-STORE-2): from an erased chip, ALGORITHM turned, the patch
  saved to slot 1 (SAVE held, KEY1), PRESETS turned, local control off
  (CC 122); the next run starts with the slot, the selection and the
  settings, and plays the slot's patch. Every run of every case: nothing
  written outside the store's region but fwtest's own image (R-STORE-1).
- sweep (R-STORE-3): a ring that has wrapped, its head one save from
  full, so a save takes a new sector, its erase and the compaction of the
  sector after it. The power cut test build stops after every one of the
  save's flash commands in turn, and part way through every page program;
  tools/store.py makes the program's bits half cleared and the erase half
  done. Every image: the store model's prediction exactly, slot 3 either
  the old patch or the new, every other key as before; then the shipping
  image starts from it, finds what tools/store.py finds, saves slot 5, and
  leaves what the model predicts.
- reset (R-STORE-9): SAVE and HOME held 2.4 s empty the store (a reset
  record) and the next start finds nothing; held 1 s, nothing happens.
- corrupt (R-STORE-5): a record's payload and another's CRC damaged, a
  garbage block, a record of a kind this firmware doesn't know: the older
  copy is read, the damaged one ignored, the counts as tools/store.py's.
- full (R-STORE-4): every sector in use and the sector after the head
  holding a live record that the head has no room for: the save is
  refused, reported, and nothing is written.
- wear (R-STORE-4, R-STORE-8): 24 saves on the wrapped ring, three new
  heads: the model's image exactly, the sectors erased in ring order; the
  selection, turned every 250 ms for 6 s, written at most once in 2 s.
- migrate (R-STORE-6): settings saved as version 1 (M6a's) are taken as
  version 2, with its defaults; a change then writes version 2.
- busy, wipe (R-STORE-7): saves under the heaviest load the panel can
  give, on a test build whose chip takes 400 ms an erase and 3 ms a page
  program (busy), and on one that has erased its own image (wipe): no
  underrun, every tick on time, every save written.
"""

import concurrent.futures
import os
import random
import struct
import subprocess

import fm_patch
import store as st

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WORK = os.path.join(ROOT, "out", "fw", "store")
IMAGES = {"app": "out/fw/app.bin", "cut": "out/fw/test-storecut.bin",
          "busy": "out/fw/test-storebusy.bin", "wipe": "out/fw/test-storewipe.bin"}
RECORDS = {"store": (0x01C00780, 0xEC), "fm": (0x01C00590, 0x40), "midi": (0x01C005D0, 0x164),
           "audio": (0x01C00550, 0x40), "beacon": (0x01C00000, 0x60)}
STORE_FIELDS = ("marker valid_sectors head head_seq append next_seq live init_ticks crc_bad skipped unknown"
                " voided records copies erases programs verify_fail refused last_result put_max commands"
                " saves save_fail resets auto_writes loaded trace_count").split()
FM_FIELDS = ("marker core1 core1_blocks patch algorithm mono voices0 voices1 voices_max stolen notes"
             " wait_max pitch_knob glide depth feedback").split()
MIDI_FIELDS = ("marker bytes ring_dropped parsed messages realtime sysex sysex_bytes sysex_long sysex_cut"
               " orphans undefined cut filtered notes_on notes_off").split()
STORE_MARKER = 0x374F5453
IMAGE_AT = 0x4000              # fwtest writes the image here (docs/HARNESS.md)
KEY_HOME, KEY_SAVE = 8, 9
ENC_ALGORITHM, ENC_PRESETS = 1, 6
WORKERS = 4
PATCHES = [fm_patch.encode(p) for p in fm_patch.TEST_PATCHES]
ERR_FULL = -2


def key(n):
    """fwtest's key number for KEYn (HW-37: control n is fwtest key n)."""
    return 13 + n


def rel(path):
    return os.path.relpath(path, ROOT)


class Run:
    """One fwtest run; its result, records and flash once done."""

    def __init__(self, out, name, image, ms, script=None, flash=None, at=(), halt_ok=False, extra=()):
        self.name, self.image, self.flash_in = name, image, flash
        self.dir = os.path.join(out, name)
        args = ["sh", "tools/fwtest", "run", IMAGES[image], "--ms", "%.3f" % ms, "--out", self.dir,
                "--flash-out", "--console"]
        os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)
        if script is not None:
            path = os.path.join(WORK, name + ".txt")
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                f.write("\n".join(script) + "\n")
            args += ["--script", rel(path)]
        if flash is not None:
            path = os.path.join(WORK, name + ".flash.bin")
            with open(path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(flash)
            args += ["--flash", rel(path)]
        for rec in ("store", "fm", "midi", "audio", "beacon"):
            a, n = RECORDS[rec]
            args += ["--ram", "0x%08x:0x%x@end" % (a, n)]
        for rec, when in at:
            a, n = RECORDS[rec]
            args += ["--ram", "0x%08x:0x%x@%s" % (a, n, when)]
        if halt_ok:
            args.append("--halt-ok")
        self.args = args + list(extra)

    def go(self):
        p = subprocess.run(self.args, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        self.exit, self.log = p.returncode, p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        try:
            import json
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "result.json")) as f:
                self.result = json.load(f)
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "flash.bin"), "rb") as f:
                self.flash = f.read()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            self.result, self.flash = None, None
        return self

    def outcome(self):
        return (self.result or {}).get("run", {}).get("outcome")

    def rec(self, name, when="end"):
        a, n = RECORDS[name]
        fields = {"store": STORE_FIELDS, "fm": FM_FIELDS, "midi": MIDI_FIELDS}.get(name)
        with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "ram-%08x-%x-%s.bin" % (a, n, when if when == "end" else
                                                                   ("%dms" % when))), "rb") as f:
            b = f.read()
        if fields is None:
            return b
        v = struct.unpack_from("<%di" % len(fields) if name == "store" else "<%dI" % len(fields), b)
        d = dict(zip(fields, v))
        if name == "store":
            d["trace"] = list(struct.unpack_from("<32I", b, 4 * len(fields)))
        return d


def run_all(runs):
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(WORKERS) as pool:
        return list(pool.map(lambda r: r.go(), runs))


# --- What the panel saves, and the images tools/store.py makes -----------

def with_sum(b):
    b = bytearray(b)
    s = fm_patch.fletcher16(b[:110])
    b[110], b[111] = s & 0xFF, s >> 8
    return bytes(b)


def saved(program_patch, algorithm_turns=0):
    """The patch SAVE writes: the one playing, with ALGORITHM turned."""
    b = bytearray(program_patch)
    b[16] = (b[16] - 1 + algorithm_turns) % fm_patch.ALGORITHMS + 1
    return with_sum(b)


def user_patch(n):
    b = bytearray(PATCHES[n % len(PATCHES)])
    b[4:16] = b"\0" * 12
    name = b"USER %02d" % (n + 1)
    b[4:4 + len(name)] = name
    return with_sum(b)


def settings_v2(channel=0, bend=2, out=1, thru=0, local=1):
    return bytes([2, channel, bend, 0] + [0] * 32 + [out, thru, local, 0])


def settings_v1(channel, bend):
    return bytes([1, channel, bend, 0] + [0] * 32)


def save_script(t, slot):
    """SAVE held, KEY<slot> tapped, SAVE let go."""
    return ["%d key %d down" % (t, KEY_SAVE), "%d key %d tap" % (t + 50, key(slot)),
            "%d key %d up" % (t + 150, KEY_SAVE)]


def ring_before_advance():
    """A ring that has wrapped, with the user slots in the sector two past
    the head and the head too full for a patch: the next save takes a new
    head, erases it and compacts the slots into it."""
    s = st.Store()
    for slot in range(st.SLOTS):
        s.put(st.PATCH, slot, 1, user_patch(slot))
    s.put(st.SETTINGS, 0, 2, settings_v2())
    n = 0
    while True:
        s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([n % 9, 0, 0, 0]))
        n += 1
        if s.head_seq >= 18 and s.append + st.record_size(112) > st.SECTOR:
            m = (s.head + 2) % st.SECTORS
            if sum(1 for e in s.key if e and s._sector_of(e[1]) == m) >= 10:
                return s.chip()
        assert n < 50000


def selection_of(chip):
    e = st.Image(chip).get(st.SELECTION)
    return e[1][0] if e else 0


def predict(chip, puts):
    """The Store model's image after these puts, and its commands."""
    s = st.Store(chip)
    for kind, ident, version, payload in puts:
        s.put(kind, ident, version, payload)
    return s.chip(), s.commands


def region(chip):
    return chip[st.BASE:st.BASE + st.SIZE]


def outside_writes(run, image_len):
    """Problems if the run changed the chip outside the store's region and
    fwtest's own image (R-STORE-1)."""
    before = run.flash_in if run.flash_in is not None else b"\xff" * st.CHIP
    before = before + b"\xff" * (st.CHIP - len(before))
    after = run.flash
    skip = (IMAGE_AT, IMAGE_AT + image_len)
    for lo, hi in ((0, skip[0]), (skip[1], st.BASE), (st.BASE + st.SIZE, st.CHIP)):
        if before[lo:hi] != after[lo:hi]:
            i = next(j for j in range(lo, hi) if before[j] != after[j])
            return ["%s: the chip changed outside the store at 0x%05x" % (run.name, i)]
    return []


def common(run, image_len, outcome="completed"):
    """Every run: its outcome, a store record, no unmodelled accesses,
    nothing written outside the store."""
    if run.result is None:
        return ["%s: fwtest gave no result: %s" % (run.name, run.log.strip()[-300:])]
    p = []
    if run.outcome() != outcome:
        p.append("%s: %s, expected %s (%s)" % (run.name, run.outcome(), outcome,
                                               run.result["run"].get("detail")))
    if run.result["run"].get("unmodelled_accesses"):
        p.append("%s: unmodelled accesses %s" % (run.name, run.result["run"]["unmodelled_accesses"][:4]))
    if run.rec("store")["marker"] != STORE_MARKER:
        p.append("%s: no store record" % run.name)
    return p + outside_writes(run, image_len)


def agrees(run, chip):
    """Problems if the firmware's start-up didn't find what tools/store.py
    finds in chip."""
    img, r = st.Image(chip), run.rec("store")
    p = []
    want = {"valid_sectors": sum(img.valid), "head": 0xFFFFFFFF if img.head is None else img.head,
            "crc_bad": img.counts["crc_bad"], "skipped": img.counts["skipped"],
            "unknown": img.counts["unknown"], "voided": img.counts["voided"]}
    for k, v in want.items():
        if r[k] & 0xFFFFFFFF != v:
            p.append("%s: start-up found %s %d, tools/store.py %d" % (run.name, k, r[k] & 0xFFFFFFFF, v))
    loaded = sum(1 << (8 + k) for k in range(st.SLOTS) if img.keys[k])
    sel = img.get(st.SELECTION)
    if sel and sel[1][0] < 9 + sum(1 for k in range(st.SLOTS) if img.keys[k]):
        loaded |= 1
    if r["loaded"] & ~6 != loaded:
        p.append("%s: loaded 0x%x, tools/store.py has 0x%x" % (run.name, r["loaded"] & ~6, loaded))
    return p


# --- The cases --------------------------------------------------------------

def case_persist(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    a0 = PATCHES[0][16]
    a = Run(out, "store-persist-a", "app", 3800,
            script=["200 enc %d +2" % ENC_ALGORITHM] + save_script(300, 1)
            + ["600 enc %d +3" % ENC_PRESETS, "700 midi b0 7a 00"]).go()
    p += common(a, image_len)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r, img = a.rec("store"), st.Image(a.flash)
    want_patch = saved(PATCHES[0], 2)
    if r["saves"] != 1 or r["save_fail"] or r["auto_writes"] != 2:
        p.append("persist-a: saves %d (failed %d), automatic writes %d; expected 1, 0, 2"
                 % (r["saves"], r["save_fail"], r["auto_writes"]))
    if img.get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, want_patch):
        p.append("persist-a: slot 1 is not the patch saved")
    if img.get(st.SELECTION) != (1, bytes([3, 0, 0, 0])):
        p.append("persist-a: the selection is %s, not program 3" % (img.get(st.SELECTION),))
    sv = img.get(st.SETTINGS)
    if not sv or sv[0] != 2 or sv[1][38] != 0 or sv[1][36] != 1 or sv[1][37] != 0:
        p.append("persist-a: the settings saved are %s, not local off" % (sv,))
    if sorted(img.live()) != ["selection", "settings", "slot 1"]:
        p.append("persist-a: the store holds %s" % sorted(img.live()))
    b = Run(out, "store-persist-b", "app", 1600, flash=a.flash,
            script=["1000 midi b0 7a 7f", "1100 enc %d +6" % ENC_PRESETS], at=(("fm", 500),)).go()
    p += common(b, image_len)
    if b.result is None:
        return p, lines
    p += agrees(b, a.flash)
    rb, f0, f1 = b.rec("store"), b.rec("fm", 500), b.rec("fm")
    if rb["loaded"] != 0x103:
        p.append("persist-b: loaded 0x%x, expected 0x103 (selection, settings, slot 1)" % rb["loaded"])
    if f0["patch"] != 3:
        p.append("persist-b: program %d at the start, not 3" % f0["patch"])
    if f1["patch"] != 9 or f1["algorithm"] != want_patch[16]:
        p.append("persist-b: PRESETS reached program %d, algorithm %d; expected 9, %d"
                 % (f1["patch"], f1["algorithm"], want_patch[16]))
    lines.append("  persist: slot 1 saved with algorithm %d (was %d), program 3, local off; the next start"
                 " loaded all three (store read in %.1f us) and played slot 1 as program 9"
                 % (want_patch[16], a0, rb["init_ticks"] / 24.0, ))
    return p, lines


def cut_script():
    return ["100 enc %d +2" % ENC_ALGORITHM] + save_script(150, 3)


def boot_script():
    return save_script(150, 5)


def check_cut_image(name, chip, s0, new3):
    """The image a cut left: slot 3 old or new, every other key as in s0."""
    img, i0 = st.Image(chip), st.Image(s0)
    p = []
    for k in range(st.KEYS):
        e, e0 = img.keys[k], i0.keys[k]
        got = (e[4], e[5]) if e else None
        was = (e0[4], e0[5]) if e0 else None
        if k == 2:
            if got not in (was, (1, new3)):
                p.append("%s: slot 3 is neither the old patch nor the new" % name)
        elif got != was:
            p.append("%s: %s changed" % (name, st.key_name(k)))
    return p


def boot_check(run, chip, image_len):
    """The shipping image started from a cut's image: it found what
    tools/store.py finds, and its save of slot 5 left the model's image."""
    p = common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p
    sel = selection_of(chip)
    base = PATCHES[sel] if sel < 9 else st.Image(chip).get(st.PATCH, sel - 9)[1]
    want, _ = predict(chip, [(st.PATCH, 4, 1, saved(base))])
    r = run.rec("store")
    if r["save_fail"] or r["saves"] != 1:
        p.append("%s: the save after the cut failed (%d of %d)" % (run.name, r["save_fail"], r["saves"]))
    if region(run.flash) != region(want):
        p.append("%s: the image after the next save is not the model's" % run.name)
    return p


def torn_bits(before, after, rng):
    """A page program cut short at the bit level: about half of the bits it
    clears, cleared."""
    d = bytearray(before)
    for i in range(st.BASE, st.BASE + st.SIZE):
        cleared = before[i] & ~after[i] & 0xFF
        if cleared:
            d[i] &= ~(cleared & rng.randrange(256)) & 0xFF
    return bytes(d)


def torn_erase(before, addr, rng, how):
    d = bytearray(before)
    if how == "half":
        d[addr:addr + st.SECTOR // 2] = b"\xff" * (st.SECTOR // 2)
    else:
        for i in range(addr, addr + st.SECTOR):
            d[i] |= rng.randrange(256)
    return bytes(d)


def case_sweep(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s0 = ring_before_advance()
    sel = selection_of(s0)
    new3 = saved(PATCHES[sel], 2)
    s1, commands = predict(s0, [(st.PATCH, 2, 1, new3)])
    erases = sum(1 for c in commands if c[0] == "erase")
    copies = len(commands) - erases
    # The uncut run first: the model's image and its command count.
    ref = Run(out, "store-sweep-full", "cut", 500, flash=st.with_cut(s0, 0xFFFFFFFF), script=cut_script()).go()
    p += common(ref, image_len)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r = ref.rec("store")
    if region(ref.flash) != region(s1):
        p.append("sweep: the uncut save's image is not the model's")
    if r["commands"] != len(commands):
        p.append("sweep: the save took %d commands, the model %d" % (r["commands"], len(commands)))
    if not r["copies"] or not r["erases"]:
        p.append("sweep: the save copied %d records and erased %d sectors: no compaction" % (r["copies"], r["erases"]))
    # Cut after every command, and part way through every page program.
    cuts = []
    for n in range(len(commands)):
        cuts.append((n, 0))
        if commands[n][0] == "program":
            k = len(commands[n][2])
            cuts += [(n, b) for b in sorted({1, k // 2, k - 1}) if 0 < b < k]
    runs = [Run(out, "store-sweep-cut-%02d-%03d" % (n, b), "cut", 500,
                flash=st.with_cut(s0, n, b), script=cut_script(), halt_ok=True) for n, b in cuts]
    run_all(runs)
    images, seen = {}, set()
    for (n, b), run in zip(cuts, runs):
        more = common(run, image_len, outcome="halt")
        want = st.apply(s0, commands[:n])
        if b:
            kind, addr, data = commands[n]
            want = st.apply(want, [(kind, addr, data[:b])])
        if not more and region(run.flash) != region(want):
            more.append("%s: the image is not the model's after %d commands and %d bytes" % (run.name, n, b))
        if not more:
            more += check_cut_image(run.name, run.flash, s0, new3)
            images[(n, b)] = run.flash
            seen.add(region(run.flash))
        p += more
    if len({region(st.apply(s0, commands[:n])) for n in range(len(commands) + 1)}) != len(commands) + 1:
        p.append("sweep: two cut points left the same image (a command changed nothing)")
    # Torn states the firmware can't make: bits half cleared, erases half done.
    rng = random.Random(7)
    for n, c in enumerate(commands):
        before = st.apply(s0, commands[:n])
        if c[0] == "program":
            images[(n, "bits")] = torn_bits(before, st.apply(before, [c]), rng)
        else:
            images[(n, "half")] = torn_erase(before, c[1], rng, "half")
            images[(n, "noise")] = torn_erase(before, c[1], rng, "noise")
    for at, chip in images.items():
        if isinstance(at[1], str):
            p += check_cut_image("sweep %d %s" % at, chip, s0, new3)
    # The shipping image starts from every one of them, and saves again.
    order = sorted(images, key=str)
    boots = [Run(out, "store-sweep-boot-%02d-%s" % (n, b), "app", 450, flash=images[(n, b)],
                 script=boot_script()) for n, b in order]
    run_all(boots)
    for (n, b), run in zip(order, boots):
        p += boot_check(run, images[(n, b)], image_len)
    lines.append("  sweep: the save took %d commands (%d erase, %d page programs; %d records copied);"
                 " cut at %d points (%d mid-program), %d torn images made, %d distinct images; every start"
                 " after them agreed with tools/store.py and saved again"
                 % (len(commands), erases, copies, r["copies"], len(cuts), sum(1 for c in cuts if c[1]),
                    sum(1 for k in images if isinstance(k[1], str)), len(seen)))
    return p, lines


def case_reset(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(0))
    s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([9, 0, 0, 0]))
    s.put(st.SETTINGS, 0, 2, settings_v2(channel=5))
    chip = s.chip()
    held = Run(out, "store-reset-held", "app", 3000, flash=chip,
               script=["300 key %d down" % KEY_SAVE, "350 key %d down" % KEY_HOME,
                       "2750 key %d up" % KEY_HOME, "2800 key %d up" % KEY_SAVE], at=(("fm", 250),)).go()
    short = Run(out, "store-reset-short", "app", 2000, flash=chip,
                script=["300 key %d down" % KEY_SAVE, "350 key %d down" % KEY_HOME,
                        "1350 key %d up" % KEY_HOME, "1400 key %d up" % KEY_SAVE]).go()
    for run in (held, short):
        p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    rh, rs = held.rec("store"), short.rec("store")
    if held.rec("fm", 250)["patch"] != 9:
        p.append("reset: started on program %d, not slot 1's 9" % held.rec("fm", 250)["patch"])
    if rh["resets"] != 1 or held.rec("fm")["patch"] != 0 or sorted(st.Image(held.flash).live()) != ["reset"]:
        p.append("reset: held 2.4 s: %d resets, program %d, the store holds %s"
                 % (rh["resets"], held.rec("fm")["patch"], sorted(st.Image(held.flash).live())))
    if rs["resets"] or region(short.flash) != region(chip):
        p.append("reset: held 1 s: %d resets, the store changed: %s" % (rs["resets"], region(short.flash) != region(chip)))
    again = Run(out, "store-reset-again", "app", 300, flash=held.flash).go()
    p += common(again, image_len) + agrees(again, held.flash)
    if again.result and again.rec("store")["loaded"]:
        p.append("reset: the next start loaded 0x%x" % again.rec("store")["loaded"])
    lines.append("  reset: held 2.4 s, slot 1, the selection and the settings were voided by one record and"
                 " the next start loaded nothing; held 1 s, nothing changed")
    return p, lines


def case_corrupt(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(0))
    s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(1))      # the newest slot 1: damaged below
    s.put(st.PATCH, 1, 1, user_patch(2))      # slot 2's only copy: CRC damaged below
    s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([1, 0, 0, 0]))
    chip = bytearray(s.chip())
    img = st.Image(chip)
    a1, a2 = img.keys[0][1], img.keys[1][1]
    chip[a1 + st.HEADER + 40] ^= 0x10
    chip[a2 + st.HEADER + 112] ^= 0x01
    tail = st.BASE + img.head * st.SECTOR + img.append
    chip[tail:tail + 16] = b"\x00\x11\x22\x33" * 4
    chip = bytes(chip)
    s2 = st.Store(chip)
    s2.raw_record(img.head, img.append + 16, 9, 0, 1, b"from later", s2.next_seq)
    chip = s2.chip()
    want = st.Image(chip)
    run = Run(out, "store-corrupt", "app", 450, flash=chip, script=save_script(150, 4)).go()
    p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    if want.get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, user_patch(0)) or want.get(st.PATCH, 1) is not None:
        p.append("corrupt: tools/store.py doesn't read the older slot 1 and no slot 2")
    if want.counts["crc_bad"] != 2 or want.counts["unknown"] != 1 or not want.counts["skipped"]:
        p.append("corrupt: tools/store.py counts %s" % want.counts)
    after = st.Image(run.flash)
    if after.get(st.PATCH, 3) != (1, saved(PATCHES[1])) or after.get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, user_patch(0)):
        p.append("corrupt: the save after it failed, or slot 1 was lost")
    lines.append("  corrupt: %d damaged records and %d garbage blocks ignored, %d unknown record kept out,"
                 " the older slot 1 read; a save after it went in" % (want.counts["crc_bad"],
                                                                    want.counts["skipped"], want.counts["unknown"]))
    return p, lines


def case_full(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    for sec in range(st.SECTORS):
        s.raw_sector(sec, sec + 1)
    s.raw_record(0, 16, st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(0), 1)        # live, in the sector after the head
    seq = 2
    for sec in range(1, st.SECTORS):
        off = 16
        while off + 32 <= st.SECTOR:
            s.raw_record(sec, off, st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([seq % 9, 0, 0, 0]), seq)
            off += 32
            seq += 1
    chip = s.chip()
    run = Run(out, "store-full", "app", 450, flash=chip, script=save_script(150, 2)).go()
    p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r = run.rec("store")
    if r["save_fail"] != 1 or r["last_result"] != ERR_FULL or region(run.flash) != region(chip):
        p.append("full: save failures %d, result %d, the store changed: %s"
                 % (r["save_fail"], r["last_result"], region(run.flash) != region(chip)))
    if st.Image(run.flash).get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, user_patch(0)):
        p.append("full: slot 1 was lost")
    lines.append("  full: every sector in use and no room to move slot 1 out of the next one: the save was"
                 " refused (result %d), reported, and nothing written" % r["last_result"])
    return p, lines


def case_wear(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s0 = ring_before_advance()
    sel = selection_of(s0)
    script, puts = [], []
    for i in range(24):
        script += save_script(150 + 150 * i, i % 16 + 1)
        puts.append((st.PATCH, i % 16, 1, saved(PATCHES[sel])))
    want, commands = predict(s0, puts)
    run = Run(out, "store-wear", "app", 150 + 150 * 24 + 200, flash=s0, script=script).go()
    rate = Run(out, "store-wear-rate", "app", 9500,
               script=["%d enc %d +1" % (300 + 250 * i, ENC_PRESETS) for i in range(24)]).go()
    for x in (run, rate):
        p += common(x, image_len)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r = run.rec("store")
    if region(run.flash) != region(want):
        p.append("wear: the image after 24 saves is not the model's")
    erased = [(c[1] - st.BASE) // st.SECTOR for c in commands if c[0] == "erase"]
    if any((b - a) % st.SECTORS != 1 for a, b in zip(erased, erased[1:])) or len(erased) < 3:
        p.append("wear: sectors erased %s, not three or more in ring order" % erased)
    if r["erases"] != len(erased) or r["saves"] != 24 or r["save_fail"]:
        p.append("wear: %d erases (model %d), %d saves, %d failed" % (r["erases"], len(erased), r["saves"], r["save_fail"]))
    rr = rate.rec("store")
    # 6 s of turns: at most one write a STORE_SETTLE_S (2 s), and the last.
    if not 2 <= rr["auto_writes"] <= 6 // 2 + 1 or st.Image(rate.flash).get(st.SELECTION) != (1, bytes([24 % 9, 0, 0, 0])):
        p.append("wear: the selection was written %d times over 6 s of turns, and holds %s"
                 % (rr["auto_writes"], st.Image(rate.flash).get(st.SELECTION)))
    lines.append("  wear: 24 saves erased sectors %s in ring order, %d records copied; the selection, turned"
                 " 24 times in 6 s, was written %d times" % (erased, r["copies"], rr["auto_writes"]))
    return p, lines


def case_migrate(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    s.put(st.SETTINGS, 0, 1, settings_v1(10, 12))
    chip = s.chip()
    run = Run(out, "store-migrate", "app", 3800, flash=chip,
              script=["300 midi 90 3c 64", "400 midi 80 3c 00", "500 midi 99 40 64", "600 midi 89 40 00",
                      "800 midi b9 7a 00"]).go()
    p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r, m = run.rec("store"), run.rec("midi")
    if r["loaded"] & 6 != 6:
        p.append("migrate: loaded 0x%x, not the settings migrated" % r["loaded"])
    if m["filtered"] < 2 or m["notes_on"] != 1:
        p.append("migrate: %d messages filtered, %d notes taken: not channel 10" % (m["filtered"], m["notes_on"]))
    sv = st.Image(run.flash).get(st.SETTINGS)
    if sv != (2, settings_v2(channel=10, bend=12, local=0)):
        p.append("migrate: the settings written after the change are %s" % (sv,))
    lines.append("  migrate: version 1 settings (channel 10, bend 12) taken as version 2; a change wrote"
                 " version 2 with them kept and its defaults added")
    return p, lines


def load_script(ms, saves):
    """The heaviest input the panel gives with KEY1 to KEY10 free: test
    patch 6 on 16 voices held on KEY11 to KEY26, each struck again in turn
    every 12.5 ms, the test tone, SELECT, ALGORITHM and KNOB1 to KNOB4
    turned 15 detents one way and back every 250 ms, MASTER swept; and the
    saves."""
    ev = [(50, "enc %d +6" % ENC_PRESETS), (100, "key 12 tap 50")]
    held = [key(n) for n in range(11, 27)]
    ev += [(110, "key %d down" % k) for k in held]
    t, i = 300.0, 0
    while t < ms - 100:
        k = held[i % len(held)]
        ev += [(t, "key %d up" % k), (t + 10, "key %d down" % k)]
        i, t = i + 1, t + 12.5
    for n, start in enumerate(range(300, int(ms) - 300, 250)):
        for e in range(6):
            ev.append((start, "enc %d %s15" % (e, "+" if (e + n) % 2 == 0 else "-")))
    v, d, t = 1023, -1, 300
    while t < ms - 50:
        ev.append((t, "pot %d" % v))
        v += 20 * d
        if v <= 0:
            v, d = 0, 1
        elif v >= 1023:
            v, d = 1023, -1
        t += 5
    for at, slot in saves:
        ev += [(int(x.split()[0]), x.split(None, 1)[1]) for x in save_script(at, slot)]
    ev.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])
    return ["%.1f %s" % e for e in ev]


def case_load(fw, out, image_len, image):
    p, lines = [], []
    saves = [(1000, 1), (2000, 2), (3000, 3)]
    s0 = ring_before_advance()
    run = Run(out, "store-" + image, image, 5000, flash=s0, script=load_script(5000, saves),
              extra=("--ipb",)).go()
    p += common(run, image_len)
    if run.result is None:
        return p, lines
    more, ln, a, _, _ = fw.check_audio_common("store-" + image, run.dir)
    p += more
    lines += ln
    more, ln = fw.check_ticks_under_load("store-" + image, run.dir)
    p += more
    lines += ln
    r = run.rec("store")
    if r["saves"] != 3 or r["save_fail"] or not r["erases"]:
        p.append("%s: %d saves, %d failed, %d erases" % (image, r["saves"], r["save_fail"], r["erases"]))
    if image == "wipe":
        image_end = IMAGE_AT + image_len
        if any(x != 0xFF for x in run.flash[IMAGE_AT:image_end]):
            p.append("wipe: the image's own flash was not erased")
    lines.append("  %s: 3 saves under load (%d erases, %d page programs), the longest %.1f ms; %d underruns"
                 % (image, r["erases"], r["programs"], r["put_max"] / 24000.0, a["underruns"]))
    return p, lines


def run(fw, out, image_len):
    """Every case; (problems, lines)."""
    problems, lines = [], []
    cases = [("persist", case_persist), ("sweep", case_sweep), ("reset", case_reset),
             ("corrupt", case_corrupt), ("full", case_full), ("wear", case_wear),
             ("migrate", case_migrate),
             ("busy", lambda o, n: case_load(fw, o, n, "busy")),
             ("wipe", lambda o, n: case_load(fw, o, n, "wipe"))]
    for name, case in cases:
        try:
            p, l = case(out, image_len)
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, AssertionError, TypeError) as e:
            p, l = ["store %s: %s: %s" % (name, type(e).__name__, e)], []
        print("store %s: %s" % (name, "FAIL" if p else "PASS"))
        problems += p
        lines += l
        if l:
            print("\n".join(l))
    return problems, lines

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 japes98
"""The store's tests (M7; R-STORE-1 to R-STORE-9), run by tools/fw-suite.py
after its suite: runs that need the flash another run left (fwtest's
--flash and --flash-out), so they are run here, one by one or four at a
time, rather than from tests/fw/boot.suite. Every input file (scripts,
flash images) is made under out/fw/store/, inside the repository, as
tools/fwtest needs; the outputs go to the suite's output folder, one
folder a run, named store-<case>-<run>.

Each flash image is read by tools/store.py, which follows store.c's rules
(docs/STORE-FORMAT.md). Where a case starts from an image tools/store.py
made, its Store model also predicts the image the firmware should leave,
command for command, and the two are compared byte for byte.

- persist (R-STORE-2): from an erased chip, ALGORITHM turned, the patch
  saved to slot 1 (SAVE held, KEY1), PRESETS turned, local control off
  (CC 122); the next run starts with the slot, the selection and the
  settings, and plays the slot's patch. Every run of every case: nothing
  written outside the store's region but fwtest's own image (R-STORE-1).
- sweep (R-STORE-3): a ring that has wrapped, its head one save from
  full, so a save takes a new sector, its erase and the compaction of the
  sector after it. The power cut test build stops after every one of the
  save's flash commands in turn, and part way through every page program;
  tools/store.py makes the program's bits half cleared and the erase half
  done. Every image: the store model's prediction exactly, slot 3 either
  the old patch or the new, every other key as before; then the shipping
  image starts from it, finds what tools/store.py finds, saves slot 5, and
  leaves what the model predicts.
- reset (R-STORE-9): SAVE and HOME held 2.4 s empty the store (a reset
  record) and the next start finds nothing; held 1 s, nothing happens.
- corrupt (R-STORE-5): a record's payload and another's CRC damaged, a
  garbage block, a record of a kind this firmware doesn't know: the older
  copy is read, the damaged one ignored, the counts as tools/store.py's.
- full (R-STORE-4): every sector in use and the sector after the head
  holding a live record that the head has no room for: the save is
  refused, reported, and nothing is written.
- wear (R-STORE-4, R-STORE-8): 24 saves on the wrapped ring, three new
  heads: the model's image exactly, the sectors erased in ring order; the
  selection, turned every 250 ms for 6 s, written at most once in 2 s.
- migrate (R-STORE-6): settings saved as version 1 (M6a's) are taken as
  version 2, with its defaults; a change then writes version 2.
- busy, wipe (R-STORE-7): saves under the heaviest load the panel can
  give, on a test build whose chip takes 400 ms an erase and 3 ms a page
  program (busy), and on one that has erased its own image (wipe): no
  underrun, every tick on time, every save written.
"""

import concurrent.futures
import os
import random
import struct
import subprocess

import fm_patch
import store as st

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WORK = os.path.join(ROOT, "out", "fw", "store")
IMAGES = {"app": "out/fw/app.bin", "cut": "out/fw/test-storecut.bin",
          "busy": "out/fw/test-storebusy.bin", "wipe": "out/fw/test-storewipe.bin"}
RECORDS = {"store": (0x01C00780, 0xEC), "fm": (0x01C00590, 0x40), "midi": (0x01C005D0, 0x164),
           "audio": (0x01C00550, 0x40), "beacon": (0x01C00000, 0x60)}
STORE_FIELDS = ("marker valid_sectors head head_seq append next_seq live init_ticks crc_bad skipped unknown"
                " voided records copies erases programs verify_fail refused last_result put_max commands"
                " saves save_fail resets auto_writes loaded trace_count").split()
FM_FIELDS = ("marker core1 core1_blocks patch algorithm mono voices0 voices1 voices_max stolen notes"
             " wait_max pitch_knob glide depth feedback").split()
MIDI_FIELDS = ("marker bytes ring_dropped parsed messages realtime sysex sysex_bytes sysex_long sysex_cut"
               " orphans undefined cut filtered notes_on notes_off").split()
STORE_MARKER = 0x374F5453
IMAGE_AT = 0x4000              # fwtest writes the image here (docs/HARNESS.md)
KEY_HOME, KEY_SAVE = 8, 9
ENC_ALGORITHM, ENC_PRESETS = 1, 6
WORKERS = 4
PATCHES = [fm_patch.encode(p) for p in fm_patch.TEST_PATCHES]
ERR_FULL = -2


def key(n):
    """fwtest's key number for KEYn (HW-37: control n is fwtest key n)."""
    return 13 + n


def rel(path):
    return os.path.relpath(path, ROOT)


class Run:
    """One fwtest run; its result, records and flash once done."""

    def __init__(self, out, name, image, ms, script=None, flash=None, at=(), halt_ok=False, extra=()):
        self.name, self.image, self.flash_in = name, image, flash
        self.dir = os.path.join(out, name)
        args = ["sh", "tools/fwtest", "run", IMAGES[image], "--ms", "%.3f" % ms, "--out", self.dir,
                "--flash-out", "--console"]
        os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)
        if script is not None:
            path = os.path.join(WORK, name + ".txt")
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                f.write("\n".join(script) + "\n")
            args += ["--script", rel(path)]
        if flash is not None:
            path = os.path.join(WORK, name + ".flash.bin")
            with open(path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(flash)
            args += ["--flash", rel(path)]
        for rec in ("store", "fm", "midi", "audio", "beacon"):
            a, n = RECORDS[rec]
            args += ["--ram", "0x%08x:0x%x@end" % (a, n)]
        for rec, when in at:
            a, n = RECORDS[rec]
            args += ["--ram", "0x%08x:0x%x@%s" % (a, n, when)]
        if halt_ok:
            args.append("--halt-ok")
        self.args = args + list(extra)

    def go(self):
        p = subprocess.run(self.args, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        self.exit, self.log = p.returncode, p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        try:
            import json
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "result.json")) as f:
                self.result = json.load(f)
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "flash.bin"), "rb") as f:
                self.flash = f.read()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            self.result, self.flash = None, None
        return self

    def outcome(self):
        return (self.result or {}).get("run", {}).get("outcome")

    def rec(self, name, when="end"):
        a, n = RECORDS[name]
        fields = {"store": STORE_FIELDS, "fm": FM_FIELDS, "midi": MIDI_FIELDS}.get(name)
        with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "ram-%08x-%x-%s.bin" % (a, n, when if when == "end" else
                                                                   ("%dms" % when))), "rb") as f:
            b = f.read()
        if fields is None:
            return b
        v = struct.unpack_from("<%di" % len(fields) if name == "store" else "<%dI" % len(fields), b)
        d = dict(zip(fields, v))
        if name == "store":
            d["trace"] = list(struct.unpack_from("<32I", b, 4 * len(fields)))
        return d


def run_all(runs):
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(WORKERS) as pool:
        return list(pool.map(lambda r: r.go(), runs))


# --- What the panel saves, and the images tools/store.py makes -----------

def with_sum(b):
    b = bytearray(b)
    s = fm_patch.fletcher16(b[:110])
    b[110], b[111] = s & 0xFF, s >> 8
    return bytes(b)


def saved(program_patch, algorithm_turns=0):
    """The patch SAVE writes: the one playing, with ALGORITHM turned."""
    b = bytearray(program_patch)
    b[16] = (b[16] - 1 + algorithm_turns) % fm_patch.ALGORITHMS + 1
    return with_sum(b)


def user_patch(n):
    b = bytearray(PATCHES[n % len(PATCHES)])
    b[4:16] = b"\0" * 12
    name = b"USER %02d" % (n + 1)
    b[4:4 + len(name)] = name
    return with_sum(b)


def settings_v2(channel=0, bend=2, out=1, thru=0, local=1):
    return bytes([2, channel, bend, 0] + [0] * 32 + [out, thru, local, 0])


def settings_v1(channel, bend):
    return bytes([1, channel, bend, 0] + [0] * 32)


def save_script(t, slot):
    """SAVE held, KEY<slot> tapped, SAVE let go."""
    return ["%d key %d down" % (t, KEY_SAVE), "%d key %d tap" % (t + 50, key(slot)),
            "%d key %d up" % (t + 150, KEY_SAVE)]


def ring_before_advance():
    """A ring that has wrapped, with the user slots in the sector two past
    the head and the head too full for a patch: the next save takes a new
    head, erases it and compacts the slots into it."""
    s = st.Store()
    for slot in range(st.SLOTS):
        s.put(st.PATCH, slot, 1, user_patch(slot))
    s.put(st.SETTINGS, 0, 2, settings_v2())
    n = 0
    while True:
        s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([n % 9, 0, 0, 0]))
        n += 1
        if s.head_seq >= 18 and s.append + st.record_size(112) > st.SECTOR:
            m = (s.head + 2) % st.SECTORS
            if sum(1 for e in s.key if e and s._sector_of(e[1]) == m) >= 10:
                return s.chip()
        assert n < 50000


def selection_of(chip):
    e = st.Image(chip).get(st.SELECTION)
    return e[1][0] if e else 0


def predict(chip, puts):
    """The Store model's image after these puts, and its commands."""
    s = st.Store(chip)
    for kind, ident, version, payload in puts:
        s.put(kind, ident, version, payload)
    return s.chip(), s.commands


def region(chip):
    return chip[st.BASE:st.BASE + st.SIZE]


def outside_writes(run, image_len):
    """Problems if the run changed the chip outside the store's region and
    fwtest's own image (R-STORE-1)."""
    before = run.flash_in if run.flash_in is not None else b"\xff" * st.CHIP
    before = before + b"\xff" * (st.CHIP - len(before))
    after = run.flash
    skip = (IMAGE_AT, IMAGE_AT + image_len)
    for lo, hi in ((0, skip[0]), (skip[1], st.BASE), (st.BASE + st.SIZE, st.CHIP)):
        if before[lo:hi] != after[lo:hi]:
            i = next(j for j in range(lo, hi) if before[j] != after[j])
            return ["%s: the chip changed outside the store at 0x%05x" % (run.name, i)]
    return []


def common(run, image_len, outcome="completed"):
    """Every run: its outcome, a store record, no unmodelled accesses,
    nothing written outside the store."""
    if run.result is None:
        return ["%s: fwtest gave no result: %s" % (run.name, run.log.strip()[-300:])]
    p = []
    if run.outcome() != outcome:
        p.append("%s: %s, expected %s (%s)" % (run.name, run.outcome(), outcome,
                                               run.result["run"].get("detail")))
    if run.result["run"].get("unmodelled_accesses"):
        p.append("%s: unmodelled accesses %s" % (run.name, run.result["run"]["unmodelled_accesses"][:4]))
    if run.rec("store")["marker"] != STORE_MARKER:
        p.append("%s: no store record" % run.name)
    return p + outside_writes(run, image_len)


def agrees(run, chip):
    """Problems if the firmware's start-up didn't find what tools/store.py
    finds in chip."""
    img, r = st.Image(chip), run.rec("store")
    p = []
    want = {"valid_sectors": sum(img.valid), "head": 0xFFFFFFFF if img.head is None else img.head,
            "crc_bad": img.counts["crc_bad"], "skipped": img.counts["skipped"],
            "unknown": img.counts["unknown"], "voided": img.counts["voided"]}
    for k, v in want.items():
        if r[k] & 0xFFFFFFFF != v:
            p.append("%s: start-up found %s %d, tools/store.py %d" % (run.name, k, r[k] & 0xFFFFFFFF, v))
    loaded = sum(1 << (8 + k) for k in range(st.SLOTS) if img.keys[k])
    sel = img.get(st.SELECTION)
    if sel and sel[1][0] < 9 + sum(1 for k in range(st.SLOTS) if img.keys[k]):
        loaded |= 1
    if r["loaded"] & ~6 != loaded:
        p.append("%s: loaded 0x%x, tools/store.py has 0x%x" % (run.name, r["loaded"] & ~6, loaded))
    return p


# --- The cases --------------------------------------------------------------

def case_persist(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    a0 = PATCHES[0][16]
    a = Run(out, "store-persist-a", "app", 3800,
            script=["200 enc %d +2" % ENC_ALGORITHM] + save_script(300, 1)
            + ["600 enc %d +3" % ENC_PRESETS, "700 midi b0 7a 00"]).go()
    p += common(a, image_len)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r, img = a.rec("store"), st.Image(a.flash)
    want_patch = saved(PATCHES[0], 2)
    if r["saves"] != 1 or r["save_fail"] or r["auto_writes"] != 2:
        p.append("persist-a: saves %d (failed %d), automatic writes %d; expected 1, 0, 2"
                 % (r["saves"], r["save_fail"], r["auto_writes"]))
    if img.get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, want_patch):
        p.append("persist-a: slot 1 is not the patch saved")
    if img.get(st.SELECTION) != (1, bytes([3, 0, 0, 0])):
        p.append("persist-a: the selection is %s, not program 3" % (img.get(st.SELECTION),))
    sv = img.get(st.SETTINGS)
    if not sv or sv[0] != 2 or sv[1][38] != 0 or sv[1][36] != 1 or sv[1][37] != 0:
        p.append("persist-a: the settings saved are %s, not local off" % (sv,))
    if sorted(img.live()) != ["selection", "settings", "slot 1"]:
        p.append("persist-a: the store holds %s" % sorted(img.live()))
    b = Run(out, "store-persist-b", "app", 1600, flash=a.flash,
            script=["1000 midi b0 7a 7f", "1100 enc %d +6" % ENC_PRESETS], at=(("fm", 500),)).go()
    p += common(b, image_len)
    if b.result is None:
        return p, lines
    p += agrees(b, a.flash)
    rb, f0, f1 = b.rec("store"), b.rec("fm", 500), b.rec("fm")
    if rb["loaded"] != 0x103:
        p.append("persist-b: loaded 0x%x, expected 0x103 (selection, settings, slot 1)" % rb["loaded"])
    if f0["patch"] != 3:
        p.append("persist-b: program %d at the start, not 3" % f0["patch"])
    if f1["patch"] != 9 or f1["algorithm"] != want_patch[16]:
        p.append("persist-b: PRESETS reached program %d, algorithm %d; expected 9, %d"
                 % (f1["patch"], f1["algorithm"], want_patch[16]))
    lines.append("  persist: slot 1 saved with algorithm %d (was %d), program 3, local off; the next start"
                 " loaded all three (store read in %.1f us) and played slot 1 as program 9"
                 % (want_patch[16], a0, rb["init_ticks"] / 24.0, ))
    return p, lines


def cut_script():
    return ["100 enc %d +2" % ENC_ALGORITHM] + save_script(150, 3)


def boot_script():
    return save_script(150, 5)


def check_cut_image(name, chip, s0, new3):
    """The image a cut left: slot 3 old or new, every other key as in s0."""
    img, i0 = st.Image(chip), st.Image(s0)
    p = []
    for k in range(st.KEYS):
        e, e0 = img.keys[k], i0.keys[k]
        got = (e[4], e[5]) if e else None
        was = (e0[4], e0[5]) if e0 else None
        if k == 2:
            if got not in (was, (1, new3)):
                p.append("%s: slot 3 is neither the old patch nor the new" % name)
        elif got != was:
            p.append("%s: %s changed" % (name, st.key_name(k)))
    return p


def boot_check(run, chip, image_len):
    """The shipping image started from a cut's image: it found what
    tools/store.py finds, and its save of slot 5 left the model's image."""
    p = common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p
    sel = selection_of(chip)
    base = PATCHES[sel] if sel < 9 else st.Image(chip).get(st.PATCH, sel - 9)[1]
    want, _ = predict(chip, [(st.PATCH, 4, 1, saved(base))])
    r = run.rec("store")
    if r["save_fail"] or r["saves"] != 1:
        p.append("%s: the save after the cut failed (%d of %d)" % (run.name, r["save_fail"], r["saves"]))
    if region(run.flash) != region(want):
        p.append("%s: the image after the next save is not the model's" % run.name)
    return p


def torn_bits(before, after, rng):
    """A page program cut short at the bit level: about half of the bits it
    clears, cleared."""
    d = bytearray(before)
    for i in range(st.BASE, st.BASE + st.SIZE):
        cleared = before[i] & ~after[i] & 0xFF
        if cleared:
            d[i] &= ~(cleared & rng.randrange(256)) & 0xFF
    return bytes(d)


def torn_erase(before, addr, rng, how):
    d = bytearray(before)
    if how == "half":
        d[addr:addr + st.SECTOR // 2] = b"\xff" * (st.SECTOR // 2)
    else:
        for i in range(addr, addr + st.SECTOR):
            d[i] |= rng.randrange(256)
    return bytes(d)


def case_sweep(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s0 = ring_before_advance()
    sel = selection_of(s0)
    new3 = saved(PATCHES[sel], 2)
    s1, commands = predict(s0, [(st.PATCH, 2, 1, new3)])
    erases = sum(1 for c in commands if c[0] == "erase")
    copies = len(commands) - erases
    # The uncut run first: the model's image and its command count.
    ref = Run(out, "store-sweep-full", "cut", 500, flash=st.with_cut(s0, 0xFFFFFFFF), script=cut_script()).go()
    p += common(ref, image_len)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r = ref.rec("store")
    if region(ref.flash) != region(s1):
        p.append("sweep: the uncut save's image is not the model's")
    if r["commands"] != len(commands):
        p.append("sweep: the save took %d commands, the model %d" % (r["commands"], len(commands)))
    if not r["copies"] or not r["erases"]:
        p.append("sweep: the save copied %d records and erased %d sectors: no compaction" % (r["copies"], r["erases"]))
    # Cut after every command, and part way through every page program.
    cuts = []
    for n in range(len(commands)):
        cuts.append((n, 0))
        if commands[n][0] == "program":
            k = len(commands[n][2])
            cuts += [(n, b) for b in sorted({1, k // 2, k - 1}) if 0 < b < k]
    runs = [Run(out, "store-sweep-cut-%02d-%03d" % (n, b), "cut", 500,
                flash=st.with_cut(s0, n, b), script=cut_script(), halt_ok=True) for n, b in cuts]
    run_all(runs)
    images, seen = {}, set()
    for (n, b), run in zip(cuts, runs):
        more = common(run, image_len, outcome="halt")
        want = st.apply(s0, commands[:n])
        if b:
            kind, addr, data = commands[n]
            want = st.apply(want, [(kind, addr, data[:b])])
        if not more and region(run.flash) != region(want):
            more.append("%s: the image is not the model's after %d commands and %d bytes" % (run.name, n, b))
        if not more:
            more += check_cut_image(run.name, run.flash, s0, new3)
            images[(n, b)] = run.flash
            seen.add(region(run.flash))
        p += more
    if len({region(st.apply(s0, commands[:n])) for n in range(len(commands) + 1)}) != len(commands) + 1:
        p.append("sweep: two cut points left the same image (a command changed nothing)")
    # Torn states the firmware can't make: bits half cleared, erases half done.
    rng = random.Random(7)
    for n, c in enumerate(commands):
        before = st.apply(s0, commands[:n])
        if c[0] == "program":
            images[(n, "bits")] = torn_bits(before, st.apply(before, [c]), rng)
        else:
            images[(n, "half")] = torn_erase(before, c[1], rng, "half")
            images[(n, "noise")] = torn_erase(before, c[1], rng, "noise")
    for at, chip in images.items():
        if isinstance(at[1], str):
            p += check_cut_image("sweep %d %s" % at, chip, s0, new3)
    # The shipping image starts from every one of them, and saves again.
    order = sorted(images, key=str)
    boots = [Run(out, "store-sweep-boot-%02d-%s" % (n, b), "app", 450, flash=images[(n, b)],
                 script=boot_script()) for n, b in order]
    run_all(boots)
    for (n, b), run in zip(order, boots):
        p += boot_check(run, images[(n, b)], image_len)
    lines.append("  sweep: the save took %d commands (%d erase, %d page programs; %d records copied);"
                 " cut at %d points (%d mid-program), %d torn images made, %d distinct images; every start"
                 " after them agreed with tools/store.py and saved again"
                 % (len(commands), erases, copies, r["copies"], len(cuts), sum(1 for c in cuts if c[1]),
                    sum(1 for k in images if isinstance(k[1], str)), len(seen)))
    return p, lines


def case_reset(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(0))
    s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([9, 0, 0, 0]))
    s.put(st.SETTINGS, 0, 2, settings_v2(channel=5))
    chip = s.chip()
    held = Run(out, "store-reset-held", "app", 3000, flash=chip,
               script=["300 key %d down" % KEY_SAVE, "350 key %d down" % KEY_HOME,
                       "2750 key %d up" % KEY_HOME, "2800 key %d up" % KEY_SAVE], at=(("fm", 250),)).go()
    short = Run(out, "store-reset-short", "app", 2000, flash=chip,
                script=["300 key %d down" % KEY_SAVE, "350 key %d down" % KEY_HOME,
                        "1350 key %d up" % KEY_HOME, "1400 key %d up" % KEY_SAVE]).go()
    for run in (held, short):
        p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    rh, rs = held.rec("store"), short.rec("store")
    if held.rec("fm", 250)["patch"] != 9:
        p.append("reset: started on program %d, not slot 1's 9" % held.rec("fm", 250)["patch"])
    if rh["resets"] != 1 or held.rec("fm")["patch"] != 0 or sorted(st.Image(held.flash).live()) != ["reset"]:
        p.append("reset: held 2.4 s: %d resets, program %d, the store holds %s"
                 % (rh["resets"], held.rec("fm")["patch"], sorted(st.Image(held.flash).live())))
    if rs["resets"] or region(short.flash) != region(chip):
        p.append("reset: held 1 s: %d resets, the store changed: %s" % (rs["resets"], region(short.flash) != region(chip)))
    again = Run(out, "store-reset-again", "app", 300, flash=held.flash).go()
    p += common(again, image_len) + agrees(again, held.flash)
    if again.result and again.rec("store")["loaded"]:
        p.append("reset: the next start loaded 0x%x" % again.rec("store")["loaded"])
    lines.append("  reset: held 2.4 s, slot 1, the selection and the settings were voided by one record and"
                 " the next start loaded nothing; held 1 s, nothing changed")
    return p, lines


def case_corrupt(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(0))
    s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(1))      # the newest slot 1: damaged below
    s.put(st.PATCH, 1, 1, user_patch(2))      # slot 2's only copy: CRC damaged below
    s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([1, 0, 0, 0]))
    chip = bytearray(s.chip())
    img = st.Image(chip)
    a1, a2 = img.keys[0][1], img.keys[1][1]
    chip[a1 + st.HEADER + 40] ^= 0x10
    chip[a2 + st.HEADER + 112] ^= 0x01
    tail = st.BASE + img.head * st.SECTOR + img.append
    chip[tail:tail + 16] = b"\x00\x11\x22\x33" * 4
    chip = bytes(chip)
    s2 = st.Store(chip)
    s2.raw_record(img.head, img.append + 16, 9, 0, 1, b"from later", s2.next_seq)
    chip = s2.chip()
    want = st.Image(chip)
    run = Run(out, "store-corrupt", "app", 450, flash=chip, script=save_script(150, 4)).go()
    p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    if want.get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, user_patch(0)) or want.get(st.PATCH, 1) is not None:
        p.append("corrupt: tools/store.py doesn't read the older slot 1 and no slot 2")
    if want.counts["crc_bad"] != 2 or want.counts["unknown"] != 1 or not want.counts["skipped"]:
        p.append("corrupt: tools/store.py counts %s" % want.counts)
    after = st.Image(run.flash)
    if after.get(st.PATCH, 3) != (1, saved(PATCHES[1])) or after.get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, user_patch(0)):
        p.append("corrupt: the save after it failed, or slot 1 was lost")
    lines.append("  corrupt: %d damaged records and %d garbage blocks ignored, %d unknown record kept out,"
                 " the older slot 1 read; a save after it went in" % (want.counts["crc_bad"],
                                                                    want.counts["skipped"], want.counts["unknown"]))
    return p, lines


def case_full(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    for sec in range(st.SECTORS):
        s.raw_sector(sec, sec + 1)
    s.raw_record(0, 16, st.PATCH, 0, 1, user_patch(0), 1)        # live, in the sector after the head
    seq = 2
    for sec in range(1, st.SECTORS):
        off = 16
        while off + 32 <= st.SECTOR:
            s.raw_record(sec, off, st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([seq % 9, 0, 0, 0]), seq)
            off += 32
            seq += 1
    chip = s.chip()
    run = Run(out, "store-full", "app", 450, flash=chip, script=save_script(150, 2)).go()
    p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r = run.rec("store")
    if r["save_fail"] != 1 or r["last_result"] != ERR_FULL or region(run.flash) != region(chip):
        p.append("full: save failures %d, result %d, the store changed: %s"
                 % (r["save_fail"], r["last_result"], region(run.flash) != region(chip)))
    if st.Image(run.flash).get(st.PATCH, 0) != (1, user_patch(0)):
        p.append("full: slot 1 was lost")
    lines.append("  full: every sector in use and no room to move slot 1 out of the next one: the save was"
                 " refused (result %d), reported, and nothing written" % r["last_result"])
    return p, lines


def case_wear(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s0 = ring_before_advance()
    sel = selection_of(s0)
    script, puts = [], []
    for i in range(24):
        script += save_script(150 + 150 * i, i % 16 + 1)
        puts.append((st.PATCH, i % 16, 1, saved(PATCHES[sel])))
    want, commands = predict(s0, puts)
    run = Run(out, "store-wear", "app", 150 + 150 * 24 + 200, flash=s0, script=script).go()
    rate = Run(out, "store-wear-rate", "app", 9500,
               script=["%d enc %d +1" % (300 + 250 * i, ENC_PRESETS) for i in range(24)]).go()
    for x in (run, rate):
        p += common(x, image_len)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r = run.rec("store")
    if region(run.flash) != region(want):
        p.append("wear: the image after 24 saves is not the model's")
    erased = [(c[1] - st.BASE) // st.SECTOR for c in commands if c[0] == "erase"]
    if any((b - a) % st.SECTORS != 1 for a, b in zip(erased, erased[1:])) or len(erased) < 3:
        p.append("wear: sectors erased %s, not three or more in ring order" % erased)
    if r["erases"] != len(erased) or r["saves"] != 24 or r["save_fail"]:
        p.append("wear: %d erases (model %d), %d saves, %d failed" % (r["erases"], len(erased), r["saves"], r["save_fail"]))
    rr = rate.rec("store")
    # 6 s of turns: at most one write a STORE_SETTLE_S (2 s), and the last.
    if not 2 <= rr["auto_writes"] <= 6 // 2 + 1 or st.Image(rate.flash).get(st.SELECTION) != (1, bytes([24 % 9, 0, 0, 0])):
        p.append("wear: the selection was written %d times over 6 s of turns, and holds %s"
                 % (rr["auto_writes"], st.Image(rate.flash).get(st.SELECTION)))
    lines.append("  wear: 24 saves erased sectors %s in ring order, %d records copied; the selection, turned"
                 " 24 times in 6 s, was written %d times" % (erased, r["copies"], rr["auto_writes"]))
    return p, lines


def case_migrate(out, image_len):
    p, lines = [], []
    s = st.Store()
    s.put(st.SETTINGS, 0, 1, settings_v1(10, 12))
    chip = s.chip()
    run = Run(out, "store-migrate", "app", 3800, flash=chip,
              script=["300 midi 90 3c 64", "400 midi 80 3c 00", "500 midi 99 40 64", "600 midi 89 40 00",
                      "800 midi b9 7a 00"]).go()
    p += common(run, image_len) + agrees(run, chip)
    if p:
        return p, lines
    r, m = run.rec("store"), run.rec("midi")
    if r["loaded"] & 6 != 6:
        p.append("migrate: loaded 0x%x, not the settings migrated" % r["loaded"])
    if m["filtered"] < 2 or m["notes_on"] != 1:
        p.append("migrate: %d messages filtered, %d notes taken: not channel 10" % (m["filtered"], m["notes_on"]))
    sv = st.Image(run.flash).get(st.SETTINGS)
    if sv != (2, settings_v2(channel=10, bend=12, local=0)):
        p.append("migrate: the settings written after the change are %s" % (sv,))
    lines.append("  migrate: version 1 settings (channel 10, bend 12) taken as version 2; a change wrote"
                 " version 2 with them kept and its defaults added")
    return p, lines


def load_script(ms, saves):
    """The heaviest input the panel gives with KEY1 to KEY10 free: test
    patch 6 on 16 voices held on KEY11 to KEY26, each struck again in turn
    every 12.5 ms, the test tone, SELECT, ALGORITHM and KNOB1 to KNOB4
    turned 15 detents one way and back every 250 ms, MASTER swept; and the
    saves."""
    ev = [(50, "enc %d +6" % ENC_PRESETS), (100, "key 12 tap 50")]
    held = [key(n) for n in range(11, 27)]
    ev += [(110, "key %d down" % k) for k in held]
    t, i = 300.0, 0
    while t < ms - 100:
        k = held[i % len(held)]
        ev += [(t, "key %d up" % k), (t + 10, "key %d down" % k)]
        i, t = i + 1, t + 12.5
    for n, start in enumerate(range(300, int(ms) - 300, 250)):
        for e in range(6):
            ev.append((start, "enc %d %s15" % (e, "+" if (e + n) % 2 == 0 else "-")))
    v, d, t = 1023, -1, 300
    while t < ms - 50:
        ev.append((t, "pot %d" % v))
        v += 20 * d
        if v <= 0:
            v, d = 0, 1
        elif v >= 1023:
            v, d = 1023, -1
        t += 5
    for at, slot in saves:
        ev += [(int(x.split()[0]), x.split(None, 1)[1]) for x in save_script(at, slot)]
    ev.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])
    return ["%.1f %s" % e for e in ev]


def case_load(fw, out, image_len, image):
    p, lines = [], []
    saves = [(1000, 1), (2000, 2), (3000, 3)]
    s0 = ring_before_advance()
    run = Run(out, "store-" + image, image, 5000, flash=s0, script=load_script(5000, saves),
              extra=("--ipb",)).go()
    p += common(run, image_len)
    if run.result is None:
        return p, lines
    more, ln, a, _, _ = fw.check_audio_common("store-" + image, run.dir)
    p += more
    lines += ln
    more, ln = fw.check_ticks_under_load("store-" + image, run.dir)
    p += more
    lines += ln
    r = run.rec("store")
    if r["saves"] != 3 or r["save_fail"] or not r["erases"]:
        p.append("%s: %d saves, %d failed, %d erases" % (image, r["saves"], r["save_fail"], r["erases"]))
    if image == "wipe":
        image_end = IMAGE_AT + image_len
        if any(x != 0xFF for x in run.flash[IMAGE_AT:image_end]):
            p.append("wipe: the image's own flash was not erased")
    lines.append("  %s: 3 saves under load (%d erases, %d page programs), the longest %.1f ms; %d underruns"
                 % (image, r["erases"], r["programs"], r["put_max"] / 24000.0, a["underruns"]))
    return p, lines


def run(fw, out, image_len):
    """Every case; (problems, lines)."""
    problems, lines = [], []
    cases = [("persist", case_persist), ("sweep", case_sweep), ("reset", case_reset),
             ("corrupt", case_corrupt), ("full", case_full), ("wear", case_wear),
             ("migrate", case_migrate),
             ("busy", lambda o, n: case_load(fw, o, n, "busy")),
             ("wipe", lambda o, n: case_load(fw, o, n, "wipe"))]
    for name, case in cases:
        try:
            p, l = case(out, image_len)
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, AssertionError, TypeError) as e:
            p, l = ["store %s: %s: %s" % (name, type(e).__name__, e)], []
        print("store %s: %s" % (name, "FAIL" if p else "PASS"))
        problems += p
        lines += l
        if l:
            print("\n".join(l))
    return problems, lines

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 japes98
import os
import random
import re
import unittest
import zlib

from tests.helpers import ROOT, load_tool

st = load_tool("store.py")


def source(name):
    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "firmware", *name.split("/"))) as f:
        return f.read()


def patch(n):
    return bytes([n]) * 112


class StoreFormatTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """Requirements: R-STORE-1"""

    def test_the_tool_and_the_firmware_agree_on_the_layout(self):
        h, c, ld = source("src/store.h"), source("src/store.c"), source("app.ld")
        for name, value in (("STORE_BASE", st.BASE), ("STORE_SIZE", st.SIZE), ("STORE_SECTOR", st.SECTOR),
                            ("STORE_PAGE", st.PAGE), ("STORE_SLOTS", st.SLOTS),
                            ("STORE_MAX_PAYLOAD", st.MAX_PAYLOAD), ("STORE_PATCH", st.PATCH),
                            ("STORE_SELECTION", st.SELECTION), ("STORE_SETTINGS", st.SETTINGS),
                            ("STORE_RESET", st.RESET)):
            m = re.search(r"#define %s\s+(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+)u" % name, h)
            self.assertIsNotNone(m, name)
            self.assertEqual(int(m.group(1), 0), value, name)
        for name, value in (("SECTOR_MAGIC", st.SECTOR_MAGIC), ("RECORD_MAGIC", st.RECORD_MAGIC),
                            ("HEADER", st.HEADER), ("BLOCK", st.BLOCK), ("FORMAT", st.FORMAT),
                            ("CUT_PARAM", st.CUT_PARAM)):
            m = re.search(r"#define %s\s+(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+)u" % name, c)
            self.assertIsNotNone(m, name)
            self.assertEqual(int(m.group(1), 0), value, name)
        # The image's window ends where the store begins (HW-5: window
        # offset n is chip offset 0x4000 + n).
        self.assertIn("LENGTH = 0x000FC000 - 0x10000", ld)
        self.assertEqual(0x4000 + 0xFC000 - 0x10000, st.BASE)
        self.assertLess(st.CUT_PARAM + 8, st.BASE)

    def test_the_firmware_crc_table_is_the_common_crc32(self):
        table = re.search(r"crc_nibble\[16\] = \{(.*?)\};", source("src/store.c"), re.S).group(1)
        values = [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r"0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})u", table)]
        want = []
        for n in range(16):
            c = n
            for _ in range(4):
                c = c >> 1 ^ (0xEDB88320 if c & 1 else 0)
            want.append(c)
        self.assertEqual(values, want)
        self.assertEqual(st.crc32(b"123456789"), zlib.crc32(b"123456789") & 0xFFFFFFFF)

    def test_records_are_blocks(self):
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(112), 128)
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(4), 32)
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(40), 64)
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(0), 16)


class StoreModelTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """Requirements: R-STORE-3, R-STORE-4, R-STORE-5, R-STORE-8"""

    def test_put_and_read_back(self):
        s = st.Store()
        s.put(st.PATCH, 3, 1, patch(7))
        s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, b"\x02\0\0\0")
        img = st.Image(s.chip())
        self.assertEqual(img.get(st.PATCH, 3), (1, patch(7)))
        self.assertEqual(img.get(st.SELECTION), (1, b"\x02\0\0\0"))
        self.assertIsNone(img.get(st.PATCH, 4))

    def test_the_newest_valid_copy_wins_and_a_damaged_one_is_skipped(self):
        s = st.Store()
        s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, patch(1))
        s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, patch(2))
        chip = bytearray(s.chip())
        self.assertEqual(st.Image(chip).get(st.PATCH, 0), (1, patch(2)))
        chip[st.Image(chip).keys[0][1] + 20] ^= 1
        img = st.Image(chip)
        self.assertEqual(img.get(st.PATCH, 0), (1, patch(1)))
        self.assertEqual(img.counts["crc_bad"], 1)

    def test_a_torn_record_leaves_the_old_copy_and_the_head_writable(self):
        s = st.Store()
        s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, patch(1))
        before = s.chip()
        s.commands = []
        s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, patch(2))
        kind, addr, data = s.commands[-1]
        for k in range(1, len(data)):
            torn = st.apply(before, [(kind, addr, data[:k])])
            img = st.Image(torn)
            self.assertEqual(img.get(st.PATCH, 0), (1, patch(1)), k)
            again = st.Store(torn)
            again.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, patch(3))
            self.assertEqual(st.Image(again.chip()).get(st.PATCH, 0), (1, patch(3)), k)

    def test_a_reset_voids_what_came_before(self):
        s = st.Store()
        s.put(st.PATCH, 0, 1, patch(1))
        s.reset()
        s.put(st.PATCH, 1, 1, patch(2))
        img = st.Image(s.chip())
        self.assertIsNone(img.get(st.PATCH, 0))
        self.assertEqual(img.get(st.PATCH, 1), (1, patch(2)))
        self.assertEqual(img.counts["voided"], 1)

    def test_the_ring_keeps_every_live_record_and_wears_evenly(self):
        s = st.Store()
        rng = random.Random(3)
        want = {}
        for i in range(6000):
            slot = rng.randrange(st.SLOTS)
            want[slot] = patch(i % 251)
            s.put(st.PATCH, slot, 1, want[slot])
            if i % 7 == 0:
                s.put(st.SELECTION, 0, 1, bytes([i % 9, 0, 0, 0]))
        img = st.Image(s.chip())
        for slot, p in want.items():
            self.assertEqual(img.get(st.PATCH, slot), (1, p))
        self.assertGreater(min(s.erases), 20)
        self.assertLessEqual(max(s.erases) - min(s.erases), 1)

    def test_no_free_sector_is_refused_without_writing(self):
        s = st.Store()
        for sec in range(st.SECTORS):

    return bytes([n]) * 112

        for name, value in (("STORE_BASE", st.BASE), ("STORE_SIZE", st.SIZE), ("STORE_SECTOR", st.SECTOR),
                            ("STORE_PAGE", st.PAGE), ("STORE_SLOTS", st.SLOTS),
                            ("STORE_MAX_PAYLOAD", st.MAX_PAYLOAD), ("STORE_PATCH", st.PATCH),
                            ("STORE_SELECTION", st.SELECTION), ("STORE_SETTINGS", st.SETTINGS),
                            ("STORE_RESET", st.RESET)):
            m = re.search(r"#define %s\s+(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+)u" % name, h)
            self.assertIsNotNone(m, name)
            self.assertEqual(int(m.group(1), 0), value, name)
        for name, value in (("SECTOR_MAGIC", st.SECTOR_MAGIC), ("RECORD_MAGIC", st.RECORD_MAGIC),
                            ("HEADER", st.HEADER), ("BLOCK", st.BLOCK), ("FORMAT", st.FORMAT),
                            ("CUT_PARAM", st.CUT_PARAM)):
            m = re.search(r"#define %s\s+(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+)u" % name, c)
            self.assertIsNotNone(m, name)
            self.assertEqual(int(m.group(1), 0), value, name)
        # The image's window ends where the store begins (HW-5: window
        # offset n is chip offset 0x4000 + n).
        self.assertIn("LENGTH = 0x000FC000 - 0x10000", ld)
        self.assertEqual(0x4000 + 0xFC000 - 0x10000, st.BASE)
        self.assertLess(st.CUT_PARAM + 8, st.BASE)

    def test_the_firmware_crc_table_is_the_common_crc32(self):
        table = re.search(r"crc_nibble\[16\] = \{(.*?)\};", source("src/store.c"), re.S).group(1)
        values = [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r"0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})u", table)]
        want = []
        for n in range(16):
            c = n
            for _ in range(4):
                c = c >> 1 ^ (0xEDB88320 if c & 1 else 0)
            want.append(c)
        self.assertEqual(values, want)
        self.assertEqual(st.crc32(b"123456789"), zlib.crc32(b"123456789") & 0xFFFFFFFF)

        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(112), 128)
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(4), 32)
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(40), 64)
        self.assertEqual(st.record_size(0), 16)

### 2026-10-24 M6b: MIDI out
- Facts: HW-72 to HW-74 (the SMK-37's MIDI OUT is a UART's transmit side;
  UART1 transmits by DMA, `TXADR` then `TXCNT`, and sets `CON0` bit 15
  when the last byte has gone, cleared by writing bit 13; the FM-1 has no
  MIDI OUT jack, so its bytes reach no socket); HARNESS.md's "MIDI
  output" (`--midi-out`, a byte every 320 us). PROVENANCE P-50, and P-43
  (the MIDI 1.0 specification) for the wire format, running status and
  local control.
- Sources: as M6a's; no other synthesizer's firmware and no MIDI
  library's source was looked at.

#### The path
One context does everything: the engine's block callback. It polls the
transmitter at the start of its events, takes the panel's events (and
queues what they send), takes MIDI in (and queues what thru passes on),
then polls again, so a message queued in a block has its first byte on
the wire in that block if the wire is free. Nothing else writes the
queue or the UART's transmit side, so there is no lock, and nothing ever
waits for the wire: a poll that finds a transfer still running returns.

#### The transmitter
A poll sends only when the last transfer has gone (`CON0` bit 15,
acknowledged with bit 13, every write keeping the UART and the receive
DMA on), never while one runs, and a running transfer's 16-byte buffer
is never touched. A transfer takes whole messages, up to 12 bytes (3.8
ms), so under a long stream a new message waits at most that plus a
block. No interrupt: the transmit interrupt's enable bit is known only
from the emulator (HW-74), the receive side is polled the same way
(M6a), and the polls a block gives are enough: the chunk lets the wire
stay busy across a block. Polling costs throughput, though: a transfer
can only start at a poll, so the wire idles from a transfer's end to
the next poll; under a stream the wire carries about 88% of its 31 250
baud (midiburst: 65 bytes in 23.6 ms). A full input wire passed on by
thru therefore builds the queue up slowly, and the policy (below)
applies. On the chip, what writing `CON0` during a transfer does beyond
the acknowledge, and whether a pin carries UART1's transmit side at all,
are open (Q-20); nothing here depends on the pin.

#### Running status
A channel message leaves out its status byte when it is the status sent
last, while messages keep coming; when a poll finds the transfer done and
nothing waiting, the wire has gone quiet and the next message carries its
status, so a receiver connected meanwhile is never left without one.
System common messages end running status, realtime messages don't. The
panel's note offs are note ons at velocity 0 (the receiver treats both
the same, M6a), so a run of notes keeps one status.

#### The policy when the wire can't keep up
The queue holds 32 messages (at most 96 bytes, 31 ms of the wire):
- **Merging:** a control change, pitch bend, pressure or program change
  replaces a waiting one of the same kind, channel (and controller or
  note), looking back from the newest over such messages only, so no
  value moves past a note, a mode message or a parameter-number sequence.
  Data entry (6, 38), the parameter numbers (96 to 101) and the mode

<!--

SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 japes98

# The store's format, version 1

The firmware keeps its user patches, the patch selection and the settings
in a store of our own design (M7; `firmware/src/store.c`, and
docs/DESIGN-NOTES.md, M7, for why it is built this way). This is its
layout on the flash chip. `tools/store.py` reads and writes the same
format, and `tests/test_store.py` checks that its constants are the
firmware's. Numbers are little-endian.

## The region

The chip's last 64 KiB, from chip offset `0xF0000` to its end: 16 sectors
of 4 KiB, used as a ring. Where the region sits is one define
(`STORE_BASE` in `store.h`) until SR-9 says which part of the chip
firmware may use on an FM-1; `firmware/app.ld` keeps the image clear of
it. The firmware reads and writes the region only through SPI0's flash
commands (HW-47), never through the code window.

## A sector

Each sector starts with a 16-byte header:

| Offset | Bytes | Field |
|-------:|------:|-------|
| 0 | 4 | magic `SBS1` (0x31534253) |
| 4 | 4 | sequence number: one more than the sector that was the head before it |
| 8 | 1 | format: 1 |
| 9 | 3 | 0 |
| 12 | 4 | CRC-32 of bytes 0 to 11 |

A sector whose header is not valid holds nothing. The valid sector with
the highest sequence number is the **head**, the one that takes new
records.

## A record

Records start on a 16-byte boundary after the sector's header:

| Offset | Bytes | Field |
|-------:|------:|-------|
| 0 | 1 | magic 0xA5 |
| 1 | 1 | kind (below) |
| 2 | 1 | id: the user slot, 0 to 15, for a patch; 0 otherwise |
| 3 | 1 | the payload's version |
| 4 | 2 | the payload's length, at most 112 |
| 6 | 2 | 0 |
| 8 | 4 | sequence number: one more than the record written before it |
| 12 | length | the payload |
| 12 + length | 4 | CRC-32 of the header and the payload |

The bytes after the CRC, up to the next 16-byte boundary, are left erased.
The CRC-32 is the common one (reflected, polynomial 0xEDB88320, all ones in
and out: zlib's).

| Kind | What | Payload, its version |
|-----:|------|----------------------|
| 1 | a user slot's patch | the 112-byte patch (docs/PATCH-FORMAT.md), version 1 |
| 2 | the patch selection | 4 bytes: the program (0 to 8 the test patches, 9 to 24 the user slots), then 0, 0, 0; version 1 |
| 3 | the settings | `struct midi_settings` (`firmware/src/midi.h`): version 2, 40 bytes; version 1 (M6a's), 36 bytes, is read as version 2 with version 2's defaults for the out channel (1), thru (off) and local control (on) |
| 4 | a reset | none; version 0. Every record older than it is void |

## Reading

Every valid sector is read whole, in 16-byte steps from offset 16. A block
that is erased is passed over; a block that is neither erased nor the
start of a valid record (its magic, a length that fits, its CRC) is
passed over too and counted. Of the records with the same kind and id,
the one with the highest sequence number counts; then every record older
than the newest reset is void. A record of a kind or id the reader does
not know is counted and otherwise ignored, and never copied forward.

## Writing

A record is appended in the head after its last byte that is not erased,
programmed in one go (a page program for each 256-byte page it touches),
and read back. Nothing written is ever written again: a record replaces
an older one only by being newer.

When the head has no room, the next sector in the ring becomes the head:
it is erased, and its header written with the next sequence number. Then
every record still live in the sector after the new head (the oldest) is
copied into the new head, with a new sequence number, so that sector holds
nothing live by the time the ring comes round to erase it. If a sector
can't be freed without losing a live record, the write is refused and
nothing is written.

## Versions

Version 1 is the first (M7). A later format changes the sector header's
format byte, and says here what changed; a payload's own version changes
when its layout does, and the reader migrates what it knows.
